summary: You choose one of two paths: one graduate core sequence (micro, macro or metrics) plus two fields, or all nine core courses. Each core course needs a B- or better, History/Institutions courses need a B+ or better, and the audit checks the 20-unit minimum. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, the overall B in each core sequence, the core field exams and the PhD minor form signed by both departments.
